title: Pocketwire Advance Fee Schedule
content:
Pocketwire Advance charges a flat advance fee on every advance and, where an advance is sent by express delivery, an express fee. The figures that set both fees for each tier are published here.

## Flat advance fee figures

| Tier | Flat fee rate (percent of the advance amount) | Minimum flat fee (USD) | Maximum flat fee (USD) | Plan fee discount (percent of the flat fee) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 5.00 | 1.00 | 2.50 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 5.00 | 1.00 | 5.00 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 5.00 | 1.00 | 10.00 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 4.50 | 1.00 | 13.50 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 4.00 | 1.00 | 16.00 | 20 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 3.50 | 1.00 | 17.50 | 20 |

The flat fee rate is a percentage of the advance amount, charged once at disbursement. The minimum and maximum are the lowest and highest flat advance fee the tier charges. The plan fee discount is a percentage of the flat advance fee that applies while the linked Pocketwire Personal Account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit.

## Express delivery fee bands

The express fee is set by the advance amount. The fee of the first band whose upper bound is at or above the advance amount applies.

| Tier | Up to 50.00 | Up to 100.00 | Up to 200.00 | Up to 600.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 1.99 | 2.99 | 3.99 | 5.99 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 1.99 | 2.99 | 3.99 | 5.99 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 1.99 | 2.99 | 3.99 | 5.99 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 1.49 | 2.49 | 3.49 | 4.99 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 1.49 | 2.49 | 3.49 | 4.99 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 0.99 | 1.49 | 1.99 | 2.99 |

All express fees are in USD.

## Band reading (hypothetical amounts)

- A hypothetical advance of exactly 50.00 falls in the first band, because 50.00 is at or above the amount; on Pocketwire Advance Plus its express fee is 1.49.
- A hypothetical advance of 55.00 is above 50.00, so the first band whose upper bound is at or above it is the one up to 100.00; on Pocketwire Advance Elite its express fee is 1.49.
- A hypothetical advance of 200.00 on Pocketwire Advance Standard takes the band up to 200.00, an express fee of 3.99.
